column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3: ...Matthew? No. You died\nwhen that world burned.\nI watched it fall.{end_wait}
Matthew? My name is\nIsaac. I do not know you.{end_wait}
Same face. Same stance.\nHow did you live through\nthe end of everything?{end_wait}
Isaac, step back. She is\nlooking at you like she\nhas seen a ghost.{end_wait}
If you survived, so did\nmy hatred. I will finish\nwhat the fall began.{end_wait}
She will not listen.\nThen I have to stop her.{end_wait}
...You are not him.\nMatthew could never have\nbeaten me like this.{end_wait}
I told you. I am not\nMatthew.{end_wait}
Then the world did not\nend for him as I thought.\nRemember my name.{end_wait}
Take your prize, stranger.\nWe will meet again,\nwhoever you are.{end_wait}
